title: Constraining cold accretion on to supermassive black holes: molecular gas in the cores of eight brightest cluster galaxies revealed by joint CO and CN absorption
question: What are the properties and kinematics of cold molecular gas along the line of sight to the mm-bright cores of cool-core brightest cluster galaxies, probed through CO, CN and SiO absorption, and do they fit chaotic cold accretion?

data.bands: CO(1-0) and CN around 113-115 GHz; SiO(3-2) near 130 GHz in the rest frame; archival CO(2-1)

what.value: Previous HI absorption optical depths and limits (e.g. Abell 2390 tau_max=0.084)

evidence.quote: Against the core of the galaxy, HIabsorption has been detected with $\tau_{\textnormal{max}}=0.084 \pm 0.011$ (cite: Hogan_thesis).
Previous observations of Hydra-A show extremely strong CO(1-2) absorption against the bright radio core ($\tau_{\textnormal{max}} \sim 0.9$)

what.value: Chaotic cold accretion simulation pencil-beam diagnostic and comparison points

evidence.loc: 8.3 Comparison with Chaotic Cold Accretion Simulations
evidence.quote: we have followed the same procedure as described in §4 of (cite: Gaspari2018) to compute the pencil-beam points

recipe.goal: Obtain calibrated data and image cubes
recipe.method: ALMA-delivered calibrated data; channel maps at maximal spectral resolution
Spectra extracted from a region centred on continuum source with size equal to synthesized beam FWHM
key_parameters: Rest frequencies from intensity-weighted mean of CN hyperfine components: CN-A 113.49485, CN-B 113.16883 GHz
assumptions: Redshifts from MUSE/VIMOS/FORS/SDSS give systemic velocity

recipe.goal: Fit Gaussians to lines with Monte Carlo errors
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to absorption and emission features; 10 000 noise-resimulated spectra; 1 sigma from 15.865 and 84.135 percentiles; emission fitted and subtracted where clear
key_parameters: Noise from rms of the continuum source's spectrum after excluding the visible line region

recipe.goal: Derive column densities and CO/CN ratio
recipe.method: Optically thin total column density from velocity-integrated optical depth at assumed Tex of 20, 40, 80 K
Pencil-beam log sigma_v vs log |v_shift| diagram compared with Gaspari et al. 2018

evidence.quote: From the sample of 18 brightest cluster galaxies observed, we find $\geq 3 \sigma$ evidence of molecular absorption in eight.
The absorption regions detected have velocities ranging from -45 to 283 km s$^{-1}$relative to the systemic velocity of the galaxy
The CO/CN ratio we find for sources with both CO and CN absorption ranges from $\sim$ 9 to $\sim$ 44.

evidence.loc: 8.3 Comparison with Chaotic Cold Accretion Simulations
8.3 Comparison with Chaotic Cold Accretion Simulations

not_stated_but_needed: Continuum image weighting, robust value, cell and image size
Exact spectral window setup and channel widths for CN windows
Spectrum extraction details beyond beam-sized aperture (position of aperture centre)
Range of line-free channels used for noise estimation
Excitation-temperature choices justification, partition functions, molecular constants used for column densities
How continuum flux was measured for tau conversion
missing_for_reproduction: Molecular constants and partition function treatment
score_reason: Public data and a clear spectral-fitting recipe, but imaging and extraction details are minimal.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple Gaussian line fitting, numeric results in tables.
